IVS
Description
These commands allow you to work with the internal virtual servers
(IVS)
Command List
IVS_ENTRY::result
- sends a result
code to the IVS client
Event List
IVS_ENTRY_REQUEST
- The internal
virtual server has received a request from the parent virtual
server (client side).
IVS_ENTRY_RESPONSE
- The internal
virtual server has received a response from the parent virtual
server
